title: Unbounded strcpy from network packet field into fixed-size stack buffer
detail: src/aurora/aurora-network/src/packet_parse.c:L20 calls strcpy(tag, header) inside parse_tenant_tag(); 'header' is a char* from network packet data and 'tag' is a fixed-size stack buffer declared at L19; no length check is present, allowing a crafted packet to overflow the stack buffer.
